item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Baked Danish omelette with vegetables, topped with a fresh tomato salad tossed with chives and parsley. Served with rye bread, mustard and pickled beetroot. Also available gluten free. (1+2+6+8+11)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Tofu lo mein, a noodle stir fry with plenty of vegetables and tofu tossed in lo mein sauce, topped with toasted sesame seeds and spring onion. Served with flash-fried green beans and edamame with crispy chilli and ginger. Also available gluten free. (1+7+8+9+11+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Classic red lentil dal in a spiced tomato sauce, served with rice, raita and mango chutney. (6+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Potato and leek soup, topped with kale, toasted nuts, baked onion and parsley oil. (6+9+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Palak paneer, Indian spinach curry with paneer (cheese), served with jeera rice and topped with crunchy namkeen. Served with boondi raita, kachumber salad, lime, chilli sauce and coriander. Gluten free, and also available vegan with tofu. (4+6+15)
